cat > /workspace/tmp/valtest.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
def comp(cfg_bytes):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN,'compile'],input=cfg_bytes,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout

valid={"version":1,"idle_timeout":0,"packet_limit":1,"prefix_width":1,"rules":[],"fallback":{"class":0}}
print("valid empty",comp(json.dumps(valid).encode()))

# bad cases
cases=[]
def add(name,cfg): cases.append((name,cfg))
import copy
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["extra"]=1; add("extra key",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); del c["version"]; add("missing version",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["version"]=True; add("bool version",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["version"]=2; add("version2",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["version"]=1.0; add("float version",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["idle_timeout"]=-1; add("idle neg",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["packet_limit"]=0; add("plimit0",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["prefix_width"]=33; add("W33",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["rules"]=[{"id":1,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,1]],"x":1}]; add("rule extra",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["rules"]=[{"id":1,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[]}]; add("empty ranges",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["rules"]=[{"id":1,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[[5,1]]}]; add("lo>hi",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["rules"]=[{"id":1,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,2]]},{"id":1,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,2]]}]; add("dup id",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["rules"]=[{"id":1,"class":70000,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,2]]}]; add("class range",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["fallback"]={"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1}}; add("tree missing gt",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["fallback"]={"feature":1,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}; add("feature>=W",c)
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["fallback"]={"class":1,"x":2}; add("leaf extra",c)
# depth >16
node={"class":0}
for _ in range(17): node={"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":node,"gt":node}
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["fallback"]=node; add("depth17",c)
# node count >255
node={"class":0}
for _ in range(300): node={"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":node,"gt":node}
c=copy.deepcopy(valid); c["fallback"]=node; add("nodes>255",c)

for name,cfg in cases:
    rc,out=comp(json.dumps(cfg).encode())
    ok = (rc==2 and out==b'{"error":"config"}')
    print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL "),name,rc,out[:60])

# malformed json
for name,b in [("notjson",b"{"),("trailing",b'{"version":1}xxx'),("nan",b'{"version":NaN}'),("dupkey",b'{"version":1,"version":1,"idle_timeout":0,"packet_limit":1,"prefix_width":1,"rules":[],"fallback":{"class":0}}')]:
    rc,out=comp(b)
    print(("OK " if (rc==2 and out==b'{"error":"config"}') else "FAIL "),name,rc,out[:60])

# big valid
big={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,"rules":[{"id":i,"class":65535,"priority":2**31-1,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]} for i in range(2048)],"fallback":{"class":0}}
rc,out=comp(json.dumps(big).encode())
print("big valid",rc,len(out))
PYEOF
